# CartoBoost Docs

Use this directory as the navigation map for the user-facing docs site.

- [Docs home](./index.md)
- [Getting started](./getting-started.md)
- [Choose a model](./user-guide/model-types.md)
- [CartoBoost Boosting Model Guides](./user-guide/boosting-models/index.md)
- [CartoBoost Forecasting Model Guides](./user-guide/forecasting-models/index.md)
- [CartoBoost Graph Model Guides](./user-guide/graph-models/index.md)
- [CartoBoost Neural Model Guides](./user-guide/neural-models/index.md)

- [Neural features contract](./neural-features.md)

- [CLI reference](./reference/cli.md)

## What To Emphasize

- Lead with the model family, the use case, and the baseline comparison.
- Keep implementation details out of the main guides unless they affect how the
  model is used.
- Use taxi examples only when they clarify a structured modeling idea.
